photograph.description: Cyanobacteria - Nostoc commune. The area in which these colonies were found is the foreground that is shown covered with snow in the following photo: 1158049 . The seaweed-like mass shown here measured 15 cm across. It is a colony of cyanobacteria; specifically, it is Nostoc commune. (For more on cyanobacteria, see 1470400 , taken on the same day, in the same place.) [See http://www.algaebase.org/search/species/detail/?species_id=24479 (at Algaebase) for some pictures, and for detailed taxonomic information.] Within its outer membrane, the colony contains a brownish gel in which chains of green cells are suspended. The colonies vary greatly in appearance according to how wet they are, but are generally olive-green to brown. Although I've shown a single specimen here, the area was covered in seaweed-like patches, up to several square metres in size.
